remarks: Welcome to 13 Wakeman Road, a charming home originally built in 1949 and thoughtfully renovated in 2012 to blend timeless character with modern comforts. The main level boasts an open and inviting floor plan, featuring a spacious eat-in kitchen that flows seamlessly into the family room-perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Upstairs, you will find a serene primary suite complete with private bath. There are two more generously sized bedrooms which share a newly updated, hall bath. Enjoy over 2900 SF of living, set on a beautifully landscaped 0.28-acre lot. The fenced outdoor living space truly shines! The stone entertainment patio, equipped with a full outdoor kitchen, TV and hot tub, is ideal for hosting gatherings or simply relaxing in your own private oasis. Nestled on a tree lined cul-de-sac with a friendly community vibe, Wakeman Road is more than a home, it's a lifestyle.
